name: git-cleanup
description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing its branches or closing out its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work gets a follow-up to remove its worktree and branches.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: A read_api token, so merged work's cleanup and issue close-out wait for its GitLab pipeline. Unset: GitLab work is not held back.
